title: Two text model options
summary:
Two text model updates led the day, alongside clearer tier docs and new user-metrics plumbing.

`deepseek-reasoning` now uses DeepSeek R1-0528, and the new `elixposearch` model adds a search-enhanced text option. Neither supports tools. The same PR also simplified ad handling in streamed responses.

Authentication docs and tier descriptions were reorganized and revised. The Special Bee request form now links to the tier docs and asks for fewer details.

Admin-only endpoints can now read and update per-user metrics separately from preferences. The change also adds ad-click tracking and revises which authenticated requests can bypass the queue.

highlights.title: DeepSeek R1-0528 reasoning
highlights.text: `deepseek-reasoning` now uses DeepSeek R1-0528, with an 8,192-token limit. Its alias is now `deepseek-r1-0528`; this model does not support tools. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek-reasoning).

highlights.title: Search-enhanced ElixpoSearch
highlights.text: Try `elixposearch` for search-enhanced text generation, with a 4,096-token limit. This model does not support tools. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=elixposearch).
